=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:1503-1507 | severity=high | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The new ask path triggers for any commit whose invocation has both an unresolved-directory warning and a `config_override` flag, but `config_override=True` is set for any `env` wrapper regardless of whether the wrapper actually selects the git directory.
  WHY: A legitimate `if true; then env FOO=bar git commit -m x; fi` (or any shell control block that wraps an env-prefixed commit with unrelated env vars) now triggers an `ask` decision instead of the documented warning-only behaviour. The PR description states the ask "applies only when an env wrapper or per-command Git configuration selected the unresolved directory", but the implementation fires whenever an env wrapper exists alongside any unresolved-directory warning, regardless of which side caused the uncertainty. The test parameter set at tests/test_pr_merge_status_guard.py:1420-1424 only exercises env wrappers that themselves cause the failure (`env -C /does-not-exist`, `env -S`, `env -v`); it does not exercise the shell-control + innocent-env-wrapper combination that over-fires.
- Requirement: "the ask now applies only when an env wrapper or per-command Git configuration selected the unresolved directory" (PR description, merged-PR guard fix section).
  Expected change site: .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py near the new branch at lines 1503-1507 (and its template twin workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py)
  Evidence of absence: The new condition `invocation.warning and invocation.config_override` does not check whether the `env` wrapper itself set GIT_DIR / GIT_WORK_TREE / GIT_CONFIG_* or a `-C` to a bad path. The PR description's stated intent (env wrapper "selected the directory") is not implemented — only the wrapper's presence is tested. The three new test cases (env -C /does-not-exist, env -S, env -v) all involve the wrapper itself causing the failure; no test exercises a shell-control-blocked commit with an innocent env wrapper (e.g., `if true; then env FOO=bar git commit -m x; fi`), which would over-ask under the current implementation.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4

=== FINDINGS FROM qwen_qwen3_7-plus ===
- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:1503-1507 | severity=high | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The condition `invocation.subcommand == "commit" and invocation.warning and invocation.config_override` does not distinguish between an env wrapper that selected an unresolved directory and an env wrapper with unrelated variables inside shell control flow that makes the directory uncertain.
  WHY: In `if true; then env FOO=bar git commit -m x; fi`, the shell control flow sets `invocation.warning=True` (directory uncertain), and the env wrapper sets `invocation.config_override=True`. The condition triggers and asks for confirmation, but the existing test `test_shell_control_commit_on_open_checkout_only_warns` requires commits from shell control flow to only warn, not ask. The PR description states "the ask now applies only when an `env` wrapper or per-command Git configuration selected the unresolved directory", but the code does not verify that the env wrapper itself selected the directory — it only checks that both a warning and a config override exist.

=== FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5_2 ===
- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:1503-1507 | severity=low | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The unresolved-commit ask fires for any recognized `env` wrapper when the directory is uncertain, including wrappers that only set unrelated variables (e.g. `env FOO=bar`).
  WHY: The PR description states the ask "applies only when an env wrapper or per-command Git configuration selected the unresolved directory," but `config_override` is set to `True` for any parsed `env` wrapper (line 485: `if index != env_index: config_override = True`), not just ones with `-C`/`--chdir`. In `if true; then env FOO=bar git commit -m x; fi`, shell control flow makes the directory uncertain (`warning` set) and the env wrapper sets `config_override=True`, so the ask fires even though the env wrapper did not select the directory.
=== END FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5_2 ===
